messages.subject: Question about getting WM and Wm
parts:
Hi Lorraine,
Thank you for your interest in Canopy and the MARATHON pipeline.

please see our function MARATHON::falcon.output(). Usage within the pipeline is found in section 4.3.2 of the MARATHON notebook:
https://rawgit.com/yuchaojiang/MARATHON/master/notebook/MARATHON.html

In summary:

MARATHON::falcon.output() takes as input:
  readMatrix from variant data (section 4.3.1)
  tauhat from falcon::getChangepoints() followed by MARATHON::falcon.qc()
  cn from falcon::getASCN() followed by MARATHON::falcon.qc()
  
Then Canopy::canopy.sample() will require from the output
  Wm = Minor_copy
  WM = Major_copy
  Minor.sd = epsilonm
  Major_copy = epsilonM

Thanks, and please let us know if you have any other questions,
Gene
